title: 1. Scope of This Policy
body: This Privacy Policy explains how Univurse Tech collects, uses, stores, and protects information submitted through this website, including contact requests, project inquiries, and communication with our team.

title: 2. Information We Collect
body: We may collect your name, email address, phone number, company or organization name, subject, project details, and any information you voluntarily include in a message or inquiry form.

title: 3. Technical Information
body: When you visit the website, basic technical information may be processed by hosting, analytics, security, or browser systems, such as device type, browser type, approximate location, pages visited, referral source, and timestamps.

title: 4. How We Use Your Information
body: We use information to respond to inquiries, understand project requirements, prepare proposals, communicate about services, improve website performance, protect the website, and maintain internal business records.

title: 5. Lawful and Fair Use
body: We aim to process personal information fairly, for clear business purposes, and in line with applicable laws of Bangladesh, including privacy and data protection principles recognized under Bangladeshi law.

title: 6. Sharing of Information
body: We do not sell personal information. We may share limited information with trusted service providers, such as email delivery, hosting, analytics, security, or professional advisers, only where needed for business operations or legal compliance.

title: 7. Third-Party Email and Tools
body: Our contact form may use a third-party email delivery service to send your message to our team. These providers process submitted information according to their own security and privacy practices.

title: 8. Cookies and Similar Technologies
body: The website may use essential cookies or similar technologies for security, performance, analytics, or user experience. You can control cookies through your browser settings, but some features may not work properly if cookies are disabled.

title: 9. Data Retention
body: We keep inquiry and communication records only as long as needed for business communication, project discussion, legal obligations, dispute resolution, or internal record keeping.

title: 10. Data Security
body: We use reasonable administrative, technical, and organizational safeguards to protect submitted information. However, no website, email system, or internet transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

title: 11. Your Choices and Requests
body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of personal information you have submitted to us, subject to lawful business, contractual, security, or record keeping requirements.

title: 12. Children
body: Our website and services are intended for businesses and general professional audiences. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children through this website.

title: 13. Cross-Border Processing
body: Some service providers may process data outside Bangladesh. Where this happens, we aim to use reputable providers and reasonable safeguards for the information involved.

title: 14. Updates to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect service, legal, or operational changes. The latest version will be posted on this page with the updated date.

title: 15. Contact for Privacy Questions
body: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact Univurse Tech at univurse.tech@gmail.com.
